# Ram Vinjamuri’s Post

Ram Vinjamuri

4mo Edited

For the past month, I have been building at Acyclic Labs as a co-founder. After an incredible stint at palantir; where I focused on AI to accelerate drug discovery, and the amazing experience of presenting at and attending Devcon. I chose to leave to build at the frontier of AI research. Our flagship product, GraphCoder, hyperscales coding agents. A single session can instantly scale from just your laptop to tens of thousands of cores with hundreds of thousands of agents efficiently and elastically, bridging the gap between local and cloud environments! We are officially opening up our beta now. If you’re a developer or engineering leader who wants to see what next-gen coding agents can actually do, we’d love to have you onboard. Sign up here: https://lnkd.in/embcZtmE Massive thanks to my teammates at palantir for an unforgettable chapter. `` ``

Last week, 120 students, academics and alumni of the X-HEC Entrepreneurs Masters spent a week in Silicon Valley → Meeting leading tech companies like OpenAI, LinkedIn, Google → Exploring the startup ecosystem through Y Combinator, StartX, Batch Ventures, Cathay Innovation → Visiting startups across AI, robotics, healthcare and consumer including Dust, Serve Robotics, Waymo, Ivalua, Vera Health, ClarityCare AI, Superhuman, Vybe, Turo, TextMe, Inc, Just Food → Meeting institutional actors such as the Consulat général de France à San Francisco – Valérie Brisset → Spending time at Stanford University and University of California, Berkeley → Discussing with VCs, and pitching in front of a jury of investors! Organizing this Learning Expedition pushed me outside my comfort zone but also made me realize how much you can actually build in a short amount of time when you just go for it. Very grateful to everyone who made this possible, especially Alain Bloch, Guillaume le Dieu de Ville, Emma von Tschammer, Adèle Rolin, Marie-Lou GOSSELET, Mathieu Metral, Elio D., Colombe Desdouits, Macky Dabo, Kourtney Arlhac, Nicolas El Baze, Mark Coopersmith, Olivier Vincent, Sina Fateh, Anne Caillat, Anne-Sophie Cambay, Nathan Denier, Robin Choy, Quang Hoang and all others who contributed to making this week a success!

Agent 37 (YC F26) hosts any agent harness (Hermes, OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, or your own) so you can give each customer their own agent in an isolated sandbox, for over 95% less than most sandbox providers charge. Every team building an AI agent product ends up rebuilding the same plumbing. Each agent needs its own private computer that keeps its files, wakes when someone messages it, and costs almost nothing while idle. Chris Nguyen at ETEC+ used to set one up by hand for each client, more than 30 times. Wes Merrill at Boon spent six months building a pipeline for it. His words: "it was not fun." So Vishnu Krishnaprasad built Agent37. Pick any agent harness and give every customer their own agent in an isolated sandbox, for over 95% less than most sandbox providers charge. What customers did with it: → ETEC+ launched a branded product in 6 days and moved all 30+ clients onto it. → Boon gave every client their own agent in 3 days. Their cost per agent dropped from $85/month to $4.94. If you've built an agent that works and want to sell it to more than one customer, try it at agent37.com. Congrats on the launch, Vishnu! 🚀 https://lnkd.in/gAF-G8zT

## About us

Agent Relay helps software teams work better with coding agents, and helps those agents work better as a team. It gives Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and custom agents shared messaging, session history, and access to tools like GitHub, Linear, and Slack. Teams can see what every agent is doing, run checked and resumable workflows, and step in when human judgment is needed. Run it in our cloud, locally, or on your own hardware.
